news.subject: Choir News
news.html:
Hello BBC Choir!

CHOIR PRACTICE Thanksgiving Weekends

November 22 is the Sunday before Thanksgiving and November 29 is the Sunday after.  Even though those Sundays fall into the holiday weekend, we will still have our regular 5:00pmrehearsals on those days to prepare for December.

WINTERFEST AT KINGS ISLAND

I wanted to include this information in our weekly email for those who weren't able to come to practice last night.  I accepted an offer for a performance contract to sing at Winterfest this year.  I'll be singing in an acapella group called "Jingle Jazz" that performs on the porch of LaRosa's in Rivertown.  Accepting this job means that I will miss some Sunday evenings in November and all Sunday evenings in December.  I will still be at church on Sunday mornings like usual.  Joe has agreed to direct when I am gone.  Thank you, Joe!

Thank you for your faithfulness!
